$schema: Layer 0 bootstrap configuration for the template. Every key is optional; anything omitted falls back to the value compiled into the application, so an untouched file behaves exactly like no file at all.
$deployment: In production this file lives BESIDE the application bundle, not inside it — the marketplace installer copies the bundle directory with overwrite="true" and would destroy customer edits. `resolveBootstrapConfigUrl()` looks for it one level up from the base href, which is why it is served here from `public/agentic-ui-config/`.
$nuxeoApiOrigin: Origin for Nuxeo REST calls, read once at startup and provided as NUXEO_API_ORIGIN. Empty keeps requests relative, which is correct behind `proxy.conf.json` under `nx serve` and for a same-origin production deployment. A cross-origin value needs CORS configured on Nuxeo — the stock Docker image sends no CORS headers, so a statically served bundle must sit behind a proxy instead.
$manifestDocumentPath: Repository path of the Nuxeo document holding the Layer 1 manifest. Created by `tools/video/mock-customer/seed-nuxeo.mjs` on a local instance. It is fetched during startup, so it only resolves once a session exists — on a first, anonymous load Nuxeo answers 401 and the application falls back to packaged defaults. Both outcomes are visible on the Diagnostics page under 'Configuration sources'.
$branding: Rendered by the shell and written to document.title. Change these two strings and reload — no rebuild.
$themes: Merged over the packaged themes by id. `tokens` are CSS custom properties written onto <html> by TemplateThemeService, so a rebrand genuinely needs no rebuild — edit a hex value below, reload, and the shell changes. The `--shell-*` names are the ones this template's own SCSS reads; a fork renames them to whatever its CSS uses. `base` names a compiled Material palette and is ignored by this template, which ships no Material.
